fact: Agence Ecofin reports Burkina Faso's AFP-PME is preparing a startup law, with draft texts examined at a national validation workshop on 17-18 July 2025.
AFP-PME held a 17-18 July 2025 national workshop in Ouagadougou to validate the draft startup promotion bill and its implementing decree, after drafting workshops from March 2025.
